info.name: Issue or exchange an OAuth2 access token.

items.docs: Exchange credentials for a Zus access token. Supports the authorization_code (with PKCE) grant and the RFC 8693 token-exchange grant (grant_type urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange) for exchanging a third-party IdP ID token. Access tokens are valid for one hour (expires_in 3600). The token endpoint is rate limited to 200 requests per hour per App Client.
